actives.name: Carrion Crows
actives.text: Two crows: weak pecks, and they draw single-target fire.

actives.name: Bone Hound
actives.text: A bleeding bruiser in the Front for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Marsh Lantern
actives.text: A Back-line light: Sanity +5% to adjacent allies every 100 ticks.

actives.name: Ember Imp
actives.text: Casts Ember each turn; bursts into flame when it dies.

actives.name: Stone Sentinel
actives.text: A two-cell tank in the Front that Provokes and Guards.

actives.name: Drowned Choir
actives.text: Every enemy −10% accuracy while it sings; Sanity attacks.

actives.name: Wyrmling
actives.text: A two-cell dragonet with a 180% Fire breath down a line.

actives.name: The Hollow Host
actives.text: Three cells of the dead strike every enemy each turn for 300 ticks, then leave.

actives.name: Sacrifice
actives.text: Dismiss one of your summons: allies around it heal 20% of max HP.

actives.name: Swarm
actives.text: Poison and Blind chance on every enemy.

actives.name: Pact of Blood
actives.text: Pay 20% of your HP: the next summon costs no MP.

actives.name: Banish
actives.text: Remove an enemy summon or add outright.

passives.name: Bloodbound
passives.text: Your summons heal you 10% of the damage they deal.

passives.name: Familiar
passives.text: The battle starts with one Carrion Crow, free.
